evidence.title: The Emperor's New School
evidence.text: The Emperor's New School is an American animated television series on Disney Channel, based on the 2000 film "The Emperor's New Groove".

evidence.title: The Emperor's New School
evidence.text: It follows the adventures of a temporarily-dethroned Kuzco as he completes his education in order to return to the throne, while Yzma, as the school's principal, will stop at nothing to prevent Kuzco from passing all of his classes.

evidence.title: The Emperor's New Groove
evidence.text: The Emperor's New Groove is a 2000 American animated buddy comedy film created by Walt Disney Feature Animation and released by Walt Disney Pictures.

evidence.title: The Emperor's New Groove
evidence.text: It is the 40th Disney animated feature film.

evidence.title: The Emperor's New Groove
evidence.text: It was directed by Mark Dindal, produced by Randy Fullmer, written by David Reynolds, and stars David Spade, John Goodman, Eartha Kitt, Patrick Warburton and Wendie Malick.

evidence.title: Kronk's New Groove
evidence.text: Kronk's New Groove (also known as The Emperor's New Groove 2: Kronk's New Groove) is a 2005 American direct-to-video animated musical comedy film released by The Walt Disney Company on December 13, 2005.

evidence.title: Kronk's New Groove
evidence.text: The film is the sequel and spin-off to the 2000 animated film "The Emperor's New Groove", and features reprises of the roles of David Spade, John Goodman, Eartha Kitt, Patrick Warburton and Wendie Malick from the original film, with new voices by John Mahoney and Tracey Ullman.

evidence.title: Kronk's New Groove
evidence.text: It was also the last film to feature the voice of John Fiedler, who died six months before the movie was released.

evidence.title: Restrung
evidence.text: Restrung is an American-Canadian independent documentary film directed, shot, and edited by Mike Enns and produced by Enns and Randy Fullmer.

evidence.title: Restrung
evidence.text: The film chronicles Fullmer's life and career from making guitars at a young age, to work on Disney films such as "The Emperor's New Groove," "Who Framed Roger Rabbit," and "The Lion King," to ultimately resign from the company and establishing a guitar-making business.

evidence.title: Restrung
evidence.text: The film made its world premier on July 1, 2014.

evidence.title: The Sweatbox
evidence.text: The Sweatbox is a 2002 documentary designed to show behind the scenes footage of "Kingdom of the Sun" (the original working title of "The Emperor's New Groove").

evidence.title: The Sweatbox
evidence.text: It illustrated the slow and painful transformation from "Kingdom of the Sun" to "The Emperor's New Groove", including the director, musician Sting (whose wife created the documentary), artists, and voice cast being dismayed by the new direction.

evidence.title: The Sweatbox
evidence.text: A major theme is creative-executive conflicts.
